Fixing it means threading per-section data from the header into the create call: a discriminator the header actually renders, and a sprite-specific read of it. 2. Switching a power moved it to the other Optional heading but set `system.enabled` to the opposite of what that heading means (a power switched off still reported `enabled: true`, keeping its effects active). The `enabled` flags now agree with the target `optional` state.

Fixes #2–#5 live in shared critter/sprite logic, so the same latent bugs on the Critter Powers tab are corrected too, consistent with how that tab's template already works. The type-check passes.
